subject: Where is my order NB-10482?

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz

body:
Hello,

The main zipper on my Fjord Rain Shell split after three weeks. I only used it on two day hikes. Order NB-10977. What are my options?

Marcus Bell

body:
Urgent safety report. My Cascade Stove started leaking fuel from the connector the second time I lit it, there was a small flare and I had to shut the canister off in a hurry. Order NB-10733. Nobody was hurt but this seems dangerous and others may be affected.

Hannah Cole

Hi, the Alder Trekking Poles I got (NB-10850) are too long for me even fully collapsed. Could I exchange them for a shorter set? I'm 5'2".

Jin Park

Hello. My box for order NB-11402 arrived today but the Granite Water Filter's spare cartridge wasn't inside, only the filter body. The packing slip lists both. Could you send the cartridge?

Carla Mendes

Sam Whitaker

Yuki

Merci,
Camille Laurent

subject: Fuite de gaz avec le réchaud

Bonjour,

Mon Cascade Stove (commande NB-10990) a une fuite de gaz au niveau du raccord, j'ai senti le gaz dès que j'ai vissé la cartouche. C'est dangereux, j'ai arrêté de l'utiliser. Que dois-je faire ?
